name: Kronos
description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
one_liner: An AI model trained specifically to read and predict patterns in financial candlestick charts, the way a language model reads and predicts sentences.
buyer: A quant trader or small prop-trading shop that wants a forecasting signal without building a time-series model from scratch.
business_use_cases: A retail algo-trading hobbyist feeds it crypto price data to generate a forecast signal as one input to their own strategy.
A fintech startup builds a 'next 24 hours' price-forecast widget for a trading app using the model as the backend.
A trading-education company builds a demo tool showing students how a foundation model reads candlestick patterns.

money_ideas.idea: A paid API that returns short-horizon price forecasts for a basket of assets, billed per call.
A subscription trading-signal newsletter built on the model's outputs.

steal_this: Wrap the live demo into a simple Telegram bot that posts a daily 24-hour BTC/ETH forecast, with premium access to more assets and faster updates — but be upfront with users that this is a research model, not a guaranteed trading edge.
